rig.force_axis: ground normal plus tangential no-slip rolling constraint while rolling contact is active

keys.name: READY_SEPARATE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Asymmetric ready stance establishes the before-state; roll contact is absent.

keys.name: ROLL_ELIGIBLE_LOW
keys.causal_role: lower COM and offer lead-side patch without touching
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Lead hand is visibly separated from ground; rear foot still owns support.

keys.name: ACQUIRE_HAND_PATCH
keys.causal_role: authored first rolling contact before foot release
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Hand/forearm earns ground contact before rear foot gives up support.

keys.name: SHOULDER_PATCH_MIGRATION
keys.causal_role: foot releases only after rolling patch is load bearing
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Support owner remains ground while body-side patch identity migrates hand->shoulder.

keys.name: BACK_PATCH_LOAD_MAX
keys.causal_role: maximum curled load with COM over migrating patch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: At LOAD_MAX the body is curled around one ground reaction; COM has overrun the earlier hand patch.

keys.name: BACK_TO_HIP_PATCH
keys.causal_role: rotation continues while contact patch migrates beneath body
keys.motion_arc_root_note: No fixed world anchor is dragged; support stays ground-owned while body patch migrates upper-back->hip.

keys.name: HIP_TO_FOOT_PROBE
keys.causal_role: prepare exit support while rotation still owns body
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Lead foot approaches but does not yet own support; rolling patch remains at hip/thigh.

keys.name: FOOT_CATCH_RELEASE_ROLL
keys.causal_role: rolling patch reaches lead foot and rotation releases into planted catch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Semantic join: rolling patch resolves into lead-foot support; no reverse interpolation.

keys.name: BRAKE_COMPRESSION
keys.causal_role: root and torso spend remaining forward momentum against fixed catch foot
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Catch foot stays fixed while pelvis/torso compress forward; paid momentum debt is visible.

keys.name: COUNTER_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: rear support arrives after torso overshoot; upper body counter-swings
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Counter-overshoot opposes prior roll direction; rear foot arrival is delayed secondary support.

keys.name: SETTLE_WITH_DEBT
keys.causal_role: secondary arm and torso lag decay after support is already stable
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Support is stable before upper-body lag fully settles; recovery is not an idle reset.

keys.name: READY_DISPLACED
keys.causal_role: action-capable exit with spatial and stance debt preserved
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Displaced ready preserves forward travel and a different arm/stance arrangement from K0.

compile.method: AUTHORED ASCII KEYS -> EXPLICIT HOLDS/TIMING -> ASCII-ONLY FRAME RENDER -> H.264 MP4 -> SPA
compile.connective_motion: NONE BETWEEN SEMANTIC PATCH CHANGES; holds only. Decisive keys own all contact/support changes.

rounds.defect: LOAD_MAX/hip rolling contact floated below the visible body and the bookend pose read too neutral.
rounds.correction: Move authored shoulder/back/hip patch geometry onto the ground contact line and reauthor asymmetric READY/READY_DISPLACED keys in the same Contact019 body.

rounds.reason: Actual decoded render now reads eligibility before acquisition, continuous ground-owned rolling support with migrating body-side patch, inverted load max, low planted catch, counter-overshoot, secondary lag and displaced non-idle recovery.

noodle_queen.taste: compact forward roll has a specific inversion and asymmetrical exit rather than mannequin translation
noodle_queen.function: patch migration is visible at hand/shoulder/back/hip/foot while custody remains NONE
noodle_queen.contempt: no generic tween bridges, no reverse interpolation, no idle reset, no metadata-only contact truth
